help_result.output:
usage: main.py [-h] {doctor,run,resume,predict} ...

GPUv1-B08: source-native adapter around VideoMAE SSV2 fine-tuning
(run_class_finetuning.py).

positional arguments:
  {doctor,run,resume,predict}
    doctor              inspect manifest files, python deps and CUDA; exit 78
                        if anything is missing
    run                 perform the real GPU fine-tune and full val clip
                        prediction
    resume              continue from the last checkpoint in --output (reloads
                        model+optimizer state)
    predict             batch clip prediction from a trained checkpoint

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
